query:
SELECT pm.id, pm.productId, p.name, pm.date, pm.type, pm.quantity, pm.documentNumber, pm.notes, pm.createdAt 
FROM productMovements pm 
JOIN products p ON pm.productId = p.id 
WHERE pm.companyId = 1 AND pm.type IN ('ESTORNO', 'ACERTO') 
ORDER BY pm.date DESC 
LIMIT 20;
